import numpy as np
# Bridge 1.9 Hz, modal mass 20000 kg per E12, k=2.85e6; TMD 800kg f=1.83Hz z=0.12 per E13-E16
f1=1.9; m1=20000.0; k1=2.85e6
m2=800.0; f2=1.83; z2=0.12; k2=1.05e5; c2=2.21e3
w=2*np.pi*f1
# crowd force: Neq~5.92 *280N
F0=5.916*280.0
# bare: zeta 0.5%, retro effective 6.2% per E17
for zeta,label in [(0.005,'bare'),(0.062,'tmd')]:
    c1=2*zeta*np.sqrt(k1*m1)
    # steady-state resonant accel = F0/(2*zeta*m1)
    a=F0/(2*zeta*m1)
    print(label, 'c1=',round(c1,1),' a_ss=',round(a,3),' m/s2 =',round(a/9.81,3),' g')
# time simulation: build-up envelope a(t)=a_ss*(1-exp(-zeta*w*t))
t=np.linspace(0,30,301)
a_bare=F0/(2*0.005*m1)*(1-np.exp(-0.005*w*t))
a_tmd=F0/(2*0.062*m1)*(1-np.exp(-0.062*w*t))
print('t=5s bare',round(float(a_bare[50]),2),'tmd',round(float(a_tmd[50]),2))
print('t=15s bare',round(float(a_bare[150]),2),'tmd',round(float(a_tmd[150]),2))
print('t=30s bare',round(float(a_bare[300]),2),'tmd',round(float(a_tmd[300]),2))
print('comfort: max<0.5 mean 0.5-1.0 min 1.0-2.5 unacceptable>2.5 m/s2')
